name: TrustDemoDT03
title: TD.DT.03 Does the national schedule count this dose?
description: For one Immunization in the child's record, decide whether the schedule evaluation counts it as given. Requirements: STD-SCH-001, STD-SEM-001. Hit policy FIRST: the rules are tried in order and the first that matches applies.

action.title: Rule 1
action.description: When primarySource is false: counts = false; why = Reported, not verified. A reported dose (J2: TrustDemoJ2HepBReported) is shown but not counted.

action.title: Rule 2
action.description: When primarySource is true and hasScheduleCode is false: counts = false; why = Unmapped: shown to the clinician. A verified dose with no schedule code (TD.DT.02 unmapped) cannot be read by the schedule, which works on schedule codes.

action.title: Rule 3
action.description: When primarySource is true and hasScheduleCode is true: counts = true; why = Counted as given. STD-SCH-001: counted by its schedule code and date, wherever it was given (J3: TrustDemoJ3HepB, TrustDemoJ3Bcg).
